name: Sunrise Veggie Egg White Frittata Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and oil 12 muffin cups.
Whisk egg whites and eggs with salt; stir in grated zucchini, halved tomatoes, spinach, feta and basil.
Fill cups and bake 18–20 minutes until set.

name: Almond Joy Chia Overnight Oats
steps: Stir oats, chia, almond milk, cocoa, sweetener and yogurt in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with coconut and chopped almonds.

name: Cajun Shrimp Omelet
steps: Sauté shrimp and pepper with Cajun seasoning in olive oil 3 minutes; remove.
Cook whisked eggs until nearly set, add shrimp mix and cheese, fold.
Garnish with green onion.

name: Pear & Walnut Cottage Cheese Bowl
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with sliced pear, walnuts and hemp seeds.
Dust with cinnamon.

name: Spinach Artichoke Egg Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and oil a baking dish.
Whisk eggs, milk, softened cream cheese, garlic and salt.
Stir in chopped spinach, artichokes and mozzarella; pour into the dish.
Bake 30–35 minutes until set.

name: Turkey Sausage Breakfast Bowl with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Brown sausage; remove. Sauté cauliflower rice and kale in olive oil 5 minutes; season.
Fry the eggs.
Bowl the cauliflower-kale, sausage, eggs, avocado and hot sauce.

name: Raspberry Almond Protein Pancakes
steps: Whisk eggs, yogurt and vanilla; stir in almond flour, protein and baking powder.
Cook small pancakes in coconut oil 2–3 minutes per side.
Top with raspberries.

name: Everything Bagel Cucumber Cream Cheese Bites
steps: Slice cucumber into thick rounds.
Top each with cream cheese and a piece of smoked salmon.
Sprinkle with everything seasoning and chives.

name: Cheddar Jalapeño Egg Skillet
steps: Sauté jalapeño and green onion in olive oil 2 minutes.
Add whisked eggs, cook until half set, stir in tomato and cheddar.
Finish under the broiler 2 minutes; top with cilantro.

name: Orange Cardamom Yogurt Bowl
steps: Stir cardamom into the yogurt.
Top with orange segments, pistachios and chia.
Garnish with mint.

name: Lentil & Egg Breakfast Bowl
steps: Warm lentils with cumin, olive oil, lemon and salt; stir in spinach until wilted.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Serve lentils topped with eggs, yogurt and parsley.

name: Cocoa Peanut Butter Overnight Oats
steps: Mix oats, almond milk, cocoa, chia and sweetener in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with peanut butter and sliced strawberries.

name: Greek Chicken Sausage Skillet with Eggs
steps: Brown sliced sausage in olive oil; add zucchini and cook 4 minutes.
Add tomatoes, olives and oregano; cook 2 minutes.
Crack eggs over, cover and cook 5 minutes; top with feta.

name: Toasted Coconut Quinoa Porridge
steps: Warm cooked quinoa with coconut milk, cinnamon and stevia 5 minutes.
Toast coconut in a dry pan.
Top porridge with blueberries, almonds and coconut.

name: Bacon & Brussels Sprout Hash with Eggs
steps: Cook bacon until crisp; remove and crumble.
Sauté shredded sprouts and onion in the pan with olive oil until browned, 8 minutes; add vinegar.
Make wells, crack in eggs, cover and cook 5 minutes; top with bacon.

name: Salmon Avocado Sushi Breakfast Bowl
steps: Season cooled cauliflower rice with rice vinegar.
Top with salmon, avocado, cucumber, torn nori and a halved soft-boiled egg.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and drizzle with tamari.

name: Cranberry Orange Baked Oatmeal
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F; oil an 8x8 dish.
Whisk eggs, almond milk, orange zest and juice, vanilla and sweetener; stir in oats, baking powder, cinnamon, cranberries and pecans.
Bake 30–35 minutes until golden. Cut into squares.

name: Egg White Veggie Pizza Omelet
steps: Sauté mushrooms and pepper in olive oil.
Pour in egg whites with Italian seasoning; cook until set.
Spread marinara on top, add mozzarella and broil 2 minutes.

name: Keto Almond Flour Waffles
steps: Whisk eggs, almond milk, melted butter, vanilla and sweetener; stir in almond flour and baking powder.
Cook in a hot waffle iron 4 minutes until crisp.
Top with yogurt and blackberries.

name: Sweet Corn & Poblano Egg Skillet
steps: Char poblano and onion in olive oil 5 minutes; add corn and cook 2 minutes.
Add whisked eggs and scramble softly.
Top with cotija, cilantro and lime.

name: Kimchi Fried Cauliflower Rice with Egg
steps: Stir-fry cauliflower rice in avocado oil 4 minutes; add chopped kimchi and tamari and cook 3 minutes.
Push aside, scramble 2 eggs in the pan and mix through; add sesame oil.
Fry remaining 2 eggs and serve on top with green onion and sesame seeds.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Protein Oatmeal
steps: Cook oats in almond milk 5 minutes.
Off heat stir in protein powder and chia.
Top with sliced banana, peanut butter and cinnamon.

name: Italian Sausage & Pepper Egg Muffins
steps: Brown crumbled sausage with pepper and onion.
Divide among 12 oiled muffin cups with mozzarella.
Pour in whisked eggs with seasoning and bake at 350°F for 20 minutes.

name: Mango Coconut Chia Smoothie
steps: Blend everything with ice until smooth.
Let sit 5 minutes so chia thickens.
Serve cold.

name: Loaded Veggie Omelet with Avocado
steps: Sauté onion, mushrooms and chopped broccoli 5 minutes.
Add whisked eggs with salt and cook until set; add tomato, fold.
Top with sliced avocado.

name: Protein Cottage Cheese Toast with Tomato
steps: Toast the bread and spread with cottage cheese.
Top with tomato slices and basil.
Drizzle with olive oil and pepper.

name: Chilaquiles Verdes with Eggs (Light)
steps: Cut tortillas into triangles, toss with half the oil and bake at 400°F 10 minutes until crisp.
Warm salsa verde in a skillet, toss in the chips to coat.
Fry eggs in the remaining oil.
Top chips with eggs, cotija, onion, avocado, cilantro and a dollop of yogurt.

name: Egg & Kale Breakfast Soup
steps: Simmer broth with garlic; add beans and kale and cook 5 minutes.
Crack eggs into the soup and poach 4 minutes.
Serve with parmesan, olive oil and lemon.

name: Blueberry Protein Smoothie
steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Serve immediately.

name: Spinach & Ricotta Egg Roll-Up
steps: Wilt spinach and mix with ricotta, parmesan and nutmeg.
Cook eggs as a thin omelet in olive oil.
Spread with the ricotta mix and roll up.

name: Blackened Tilapia Breakfast Tacos
steps: Coat tilapia in Cajun seasoning and sear in olive oil 3 minutes per side; flake.
Scramble eggs.
Toss slaw with yogurt and lime juice.
Fill warm tortillas with fish, egg, slaw and cilantro.

name: Warm Lentil & Feta Breakfast Salad
steps: Warm lentils with olive oil, lemon and salt.
Toss with tomatoes, cucumber and parsley.
Top with feta and halved soft-boiled eggs.

name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Egg Cups
steps: Line 6 muffin cups with prosciutto slices.
Add a little chopped spinach, crack in an egg, top with parmesan and pepper.
Bake at 400°F for 12–15 minutes.

name: Carrot Cake Overnight Oats
steps: Mix oats, grated carrot, almond milk, yogurt, spices, vanilla and sweetener.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with walnuts.

name: Bean & Cheese Breakfast Bowl
steps: Warm beans with cumin and mash lightly.
Fry the eggs in olive oil.
Layer beans, eggs, cheddar, salsa, avocado and green onion in a bowl.

name: Avocado Egg Salad Toast
steps: Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Chop hard-boiled eggs and fold in with chives.
Pile onto toasted bread; sprinkle pepper flakes.

name: Cauliflower Oatmeal (Low-Carb Porridge)
steps: Simmer cauliflower rice in almond milk 5 minutes until tender.
Whisk in egg whites and flaxseed; cook 2 minutes stirring until thick.
Add cinnamon, vanilla, sweetener; top with pecans and raspberries.

name: Turkey Club Breakfast Lettuce Wraps
steps: Cook turkey bacon until crisp.
Spread romaine leaves with mayo; layer turkey, bacon, sliced egg, tomato and avocado.
Roll and eat.

name: Cardamom Pear Steel-Cut Oats
steps: Simmer steel-cut oats in water 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in almond milk, cardamom and cinnamon.
Top with diced pear, almonds and yogurt.

name: Southwest Egg White Breakfast Pizza on Tortilla
steps: Crisp the tortilla in a skillet with olive oil.
Scramble egg whites, spread over the tortilla with beans and salsa.
Top with cheese, broil 2 minutes, add green onion and slice.

name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad (Light Dressing)
steps: Season chicken, grill 6 minutes per side, rest and slice.
Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, mashed anchovies, garlic and olive oil into a dressing.
Toss romaine with dressing, top with chicken, parmesan, pepper and crumbled crackers.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
steps: Combine chickpeas, diced cucumber, halved tomatoes, thin red onion, olives and parsley.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano and salt; toss with the salad.
Fold in feta and chill 20 minutes before serving.

name: Cobb Salad with Avocado Ranch
steps: Cook chicken in olive oil, slice; hard-boil eggs; crisp turkey bacon.
Blend half the avocado with yogurt, ranch seasoning and lemon juice for the dressing.
Arrange romaine with rows of chicken, egg, bacon, remaining avocado, tomato and blue cheese; drizzle dressing.

name: Kale & Quinoa Power Salad with Lemon Tahini
steps: Massage chopped kale with a pinch of salt for 1 minute to soften.
Whisk tahini, lemon juice, garlic, water and salt into a smooth dressing.
Toss kale with quinoa, chickpeas, shredded carrot and cabbage; drizzle dressing and top with pumpkin seeds.

name: Tuna Niçoise Salad
steps: Boil potatoes until tender; blanch green beans 3 minutes; hard-boil eggs.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, Dijon and mashed anchovy.
Arrange greens, tuna, potatoes, beans, eggs, tomatoes and olives; drizzle with dressing.

name: Asian Chicken Chopped Salad
steps: Whisk tamari, rice vinegar, sesame oil, grated ginger and peanut butter into a dressing.
Toss shredded chicken, cabbages, carrot, edamame, green onion and cilantro.
Dress just before serving and top with sliced almonds.

name: Greek Salad with Grilled Shrimp
steps: Toss shrimp with oregano and half the olive oil; grill 2–3 minutes per side.
Combine romaine, cucumber, tomato, onion and olives.
Dress with remaining oil and vinegar; top with feta and shrimp.

name: Southwest Black Bean & Avocado Salad
steps: Combine beans, corn, diced pepper, tomatoes, red onion and cilantro.
Whisk lime juice, olive oil, cumin, chili powder and salt.
Toss, fold in diced avocado just before serving.

name: Salmon Avocado Salad with Dill Dressing
steps: Season salmon and roast at 400°F for 12 minutes; flake.
Whisk yogurt, dill, lemon juice and salt for the dressing.
Toss greens, cucumber and radish with olive oil; top with salmon, avocado and dressing.

name: Lentil Tabbouleh
steps: Finely chop parsley, mint, tomato, cucumber and green onion.
Combine with cooked lentils.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil and salt; rest 15 minutes.

name: Buffalo Chicken Salad
steps: Sear chicken in olive oil, slice and toss with hot sauce melted with butter.
Mix yogurt, crumbled blue cheese and lemon juice into a dressing.
Serve chicken over romaine, celery and carrot with the dressing.

name: Caprese Salad with White Beans
steps: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella; arrange on a platter with white beans.
Tuck basil leaves between slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic; season.

name: Steak Salad with Chimichurri
steps: Season steak and grill 4–5 minutes per side; rest 5 minutes and slice thin.
Blend parsley, cilantro, garlic, vinegar, olive oil, pepper flakes and salt into chimichurri.
Toss arugula, tomatoes and onion; top with steak and chimichurri.

name: Thai Peanut Slaw with Edamame
steps: Whisk peanut butter, lime juice, tamari, sesame oil, ginger and water until smooth.
Toss slaw, cabbage, edamame, pepper, green onion and cilantro.
Dress and top with chopped peanuts.

name: Shrimp Louie Salad
steps: Poach shrimp 3 minutes; chill.
Mix yogurt, mayo, tomato paste, lemon juice and hot sauce for Louie dressing.
Plate lettuce, shrimp, quartered eggs, tomato, cucumber and avocado; spoon dressing over.

name: Farro & Roasted Vegetable Salad
steps: Roast zucchini, pepper and onion tossed with half the oil at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Combine farro, roasted vegetables, tomatoes and arugula.
Dress with remaining oil, balsamic and salt; top with feta and basil.

name: Chicken Waldorf Salad (Yogurt Dressing)
steps: Dice chicken, apple and celery.
Mix yogurt, lemon juice, Dijon and salt; fold in chicken mix and walnuts.
Serve in butter lettuce cups.

name: Roasted Beet & Goat Cheese Salad
steps: Wrap beets in foil and roast at 400°F for 45 minutes; peel and slice.
Toss arugula with olive oil, balsamic and salt.
Top with beets, orange segments, goat cheese and walnuts.

name: Tuna & White Bean Salad
steps: Flake tuna and combine with beans, onion, celery, parsley and capers.
Dress with olive oil and lemon juice.
Serve over arugula.

name: Spinach Strawberry Salad with Grilled Chicken
steps: Grill seasoned chicken 6 minutes per side; slice.
Whisk olive oil, balsamic and Dijon.
Toss spinach, strawberries and onion with dressing; top with chicken, goat cheese and almonds.

name: Egg & Avocado Chopped Salad
steps: Hard-boil eggs; crisp turkey bacon.
Chop everything into small dice.
Toss with olive oil, lemon, Dijon and chives.

name: Moroccan Carrot & Chickpea Salad
steps: Shred carrots and combine with chickpeas, cilantro and mint.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, cumin, coriander, cinnamon and salt.
Toss and top with toasted almonds.

name: Seared Ahi Tuna Salad with Ginger Dressing
steps: Coat tuna in sesame seeds and sear in avocado oil 1 minute per side; slice.
Whisk tamari, rice vinegar, grated ginger and sesame oil.
Plate greens, cucumber, avocado and edamame; top with tuna and dressing.

name: Broccoli Crunch Salad with Turkey Bacon
steps: Cook turkey bacon until crisp; chop.
Mix yogurt, mayo, vinegar and sweetener.
Toss chopped raw broccoli, onion, seeds, cheddar and bacon with the dressing; chill 30 minutes.

name: Grilled Feta & Cucumber Salad
steps: Sear thick feta slices in a dry nonstick pan 2 minutes per side until golden.
Toss cucumber, tomatoes, olives and mint with olive oil, lemon and oregano.
Top with warm feta.

name: Chicken Shawarma Salad
steps: Marinate chicken in spices, garlic, half the lemon and oil for 15 minutes; sear 6 minutes per side and slice.
Whisk tahini, yogurt, remaining lemon and water to a sauce.
Serve chicken over romaine, tomato, cucumber and onion with sauce and parsley.

name: Wild Rice, Cranberry & Pecan Salad
steps: Combine wild rice, chopped cranberries, pecans, celery, green onion and parsley.
Whisk orange juice, zest, olive oil, vinegar and salt.
Toss and serve at room temperature.

name: Crab & Avocado Salad
steps: Gently mix crab with celery, onion, yogurt, Dijon, lemon and Old Bay.
Fold in diced avocado.
Serve in lettuce cups with chives.

name: Roasted Cauliflower & Chickpea Salad with Tahini
steps: Toss cauliflower and chickpeas with oil, cumin and paprika; roast at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Whisk tahini, lemon, garlic and water.
Serve warm over arugula with tahini sauce, parsley and pomegranate.

name: Turkey Taco Salad
steps: Brown turkey in olive oil with taco seasoning, 8 minutes.
Layer romaine, beans, tomatoes and turkey in bowls.
Top with cheddar, avocado, salsa, yogurt and cilantro.

name: Cucumber Dill Salmon Salad
steps: Mix salmon with yogurt, dill, onion, lemon juice and capers.
Slice cucumber thin and toss with pepper.
Serve salmon salad over greens and cucumber.

name: Italian Antipasto Salad
steps: Chop romaine, turkey, mozzarella, artichokes and peppers.
Toss with olives and chickpeas.
Dress with olive oil, vinegar and oregano.

name: Warm Brussels Sprout Salad with Bacon & Pecans
steps: Cook bacon until crisp; crumble. Sauté shallot and shredded sprouts in the pan with olive oil 6 minutes.
Whisk vinegar and Dijon into the pan.
Toss with pecans, bacon and parmesan.

name: Chicken & Avocado Salad with Cilantro Lime
steps: Mash half the avocado with lime juice, yogurt and salt.
Fold in shredded chicken, diced avocado, onion, jalapeño and cilantro.
Serve over romaine.

name: Quinoa Greek Salad
steps: Combine quinoa, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives and parsley.
Dress with olive oil, lemon, oregano and salt.
Fold in feta; chill.

name: Blackened Shrimp Caesar with Kale
steps: Toss shrimp in Cajun seasoning and sear in half the oil 2 minutes per side.
Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, garlic and remaining oil; massage into chopped kale.
Top with shrimp, parmesan and pumpkin seeds.

name: Arugula, Pear & Walnut Salad with Chicken
steps: Season and pan-sear chicken 6 minutes per side; slice.
Whisk oil, vinegar and Dijon.
Toss arugula and sliced pear with dressing; top with chicken, walnuts and blue cheese.

name: Edamame & Cucumber Sesame Salad
steps: Slice cucumber and radish thin.
Whisk rice vinegar, tamari, sesame oil and ginger.
Toss with edamame and green onion; sprinkle sesame seeds.

name: BBQ Chicken Chopped Salad (No-Sugar BBQ)
steps: Mix tomato paste, vinegar, paprika and sweetener into a quick BBQ sauce; brush over chicken and grill 6 minutes per side; slice.
Mix yogurt with ranch seasoning.
Toss romaine, beans, corn, tomatoes and cheddar; top with chicken and ranch.

name: Smoked Mackerel & Beet Salad
steps: Flake mackerel and slice cooked beets.
Mix yogurt, dill and lemon.
Arrange greens, beets, onion and mackerel; drizzle yogurt and olive oil.

name: Chopped Italian Chicken Salad
steps: Season and grill chicken; dice.
Chop romaine, cucumber, tomatoes and mozzarella.
Toss with chickpeas, basil and the oil-vinegar-seasoning dressing.

name: Spicy Tuna Poke Bowl over Greens
steps: Dice tuna and toss with tamari, sesame oil, sriracha and mayo.
Arrange greens, cucumber, avocado and edamame in bowls.
Top with tuna, green onion, sesame seeds and torn nori.

name: Roasted Sweet Potato & Kale Salad
steps: Roast diced sweet potato with half the oil, cinnamon and salt at 425°F for 22 minutes.
Massage kale with remaining oil, vinegar and Dijon.
Toss with sweet potato, chickpeas, pumpkin seeds and goat cheese.

name: Chicken Cabbage Crunch Salad
steps: Shred cabbage and carrot; slice green onion.
Whisk vinegar, oil, Dijon and sweetener.
Toss with chicken, almonds and seeds.

name: Lemon Herb Shrimp & Cucumber Salad
steps: Sauté shrimp with garlic in half the oil 3 minutes; cool slightly.
Toss cucumber, tomatoes, chickpeas, herbs with lemon and remaining oil.
Add shrimp and feta.

name: Autumn Chicken Salad with Apple & Pecans
steps: Grill chicken; slice.
Whisk oil, vinegar and Dijon.
Toss greens, apple, onion with dressing; top with chicken, pecans and cheddar.

name: Smashed Cucumber Salad with Tofu
steps: Smash cucumbers with the flat of a knife, cut into chunks and salt 5 minutes; drain.
Pan-fry tofu cubes in avocado oil until golden.
Toss cucumber and tofu with garlic, vinegar, tamari, sesame oil, chili crisp and cilantro.

name: Turkey, Cranberry & Walnut Salad
steps: Whisk olive oil, orange juice and vinegar.
Toss greens, celery, chopped cranberries with dressing.
Top with turkey, walnuts and goat cheese.

name: Mexican Street Corn-Style Chicken Salad
steps: Grill chicken; dice. Char corn in a dry skillet 4 minutes.
Mix yogurt, mayo, lime, chili powder.
Toss romaine, chicken, corn, jalapeño, cilantro with dressing; top with cotija.

name: Salmon Sushi Salad
steps: Roast salmon at 400°F 12 minutes; flake.
Whisk rice vinegar, tamari, sesame oil and ginger.
Toss greens, cucumber, avocado, carrot, edamame; top with salmon, nori strips and sesame.

name: Three-Bean Salad (No Sugar)
steps: Blanch green beans 3 minutes; cool.
Whisk vinegar, oil, Dijon, sweetener and salt.
Toss all beans, onion and parsley with dressing; marinate 1 hour.

name: Grilled Halloumi-Style Feta & Chickpea Salad
steps: Sear feta slices 2 minutes per side.
Toss chickpeas, arugula, tomatoes, cucumber and mint with lemon, oil and sumac.
Top with feta.

name: Tofu Sesame Ginger Salad
steps: Pan-fry tofu cubes in avocado oil until crisp.
Whisk tamari, vinegar, sesame oil and ginger.
Toss vegetables with dressing; top with tofu and almonds.

name: Chicken Pesto Zoodle Salad
steps: Sear chicken in olive oil; slice.
Toss raw zoodles with pesto.
Add tomatoes, mozzarella, chicken and pine nuts.

name: Shredded Chicken Kale Caesar
steps: Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, mashed anchovy, garlic and oil.
Massage dressing into chopped kale.
Top with chicken, parmesan and hemp seeds.

name: Fennel, Orange & Olive Salad with Sardines
steps: Shave fennel thin; segment orange.
Toss with olives, onion, olive oil, lemon and parsley.
Top with sardines and pepper.
